name: Ende

queries.query: Ende Indonesia official cadastral parcel map ATR BPN
queries.result: First-party discovery identified the official BHUMI interactive map, ATLAS geospatial portal, and the local Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Ende site. No Ende-specific public parcel endpoint or safe anonymous feature response was identified.

queries.query: Ende Indonesia peta bidang tanah resmi ATR BPN; Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Ende layanan peta bidang tanah resmi
queries.result: Pencarian berbahasa Indonesia menemukan portal resmi BHUMI/ATLAS ATR/BPN dan situs yang mengaku sebagai Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Ende, tetapi tidak menemukan layanan publik khusus Ende dengan respons bidang tanah anonim yang memuat ID asli dan geometri. Konten situs lokal yang diambil berisi materi/tautan Bandar Lampung, sehingga tidak diperlakukan sebagai bukti layanan kadaster Ende.

officialSourceAssessment.localCustodian: Kantor Pertanahan Kabupaten Ende is identified by the local site, but its retrieved content did not expose an Ende parcel map/API and included Bandar Lampung references; local parcel custody and public vector coverage remain unverified.
regionalOrNationalSources: BHUMI ATR/BPN official help says its interactive map disseminates spatial information and includes land-parcel layers.
ATLAS is the official ATR/BPN geospatial portal; its public catalog described datasets including land-related layers, but no Ende parcel dataset or anonymous feature response was exposed.
The local site is general land-office/service prose and is not parcel-vector evidence.
officialSourceAssessment.registryEvidence: No Ende-specific public registry/map/procedure with usable parcel geometry and stable native identity was identified; registryFound remains null.

requestOutcomes: TLS-verified anonymous GET of https://bhumi.atrbpn.go.id/ returned HTTP 200. TLS-verified GET of https://bhumi.atrbpn.go.id/bantuan/peta returned HTTP 200 and confirmed the public map/help surface. The current BHUMI Next.js entrypoints referenced by the page were fetched and inspected; no safe anonymous Ende parcel feature request, schema, CRS, or native identity response was exposed. TLS-verified GET of https://atlas.atrbpn.go.id/ returned HTTP 200; the current public catalog showed seven published sources at inspection time, but no Ende parcel layer, service URL, schema, CRS, or feature response. TLS-verified GET of https://www.bpnkabende.com/ returned HTTP 200, but the retrieved page contained Bandar Lampung branding/links and no Ende parcel-vector endpoint. No login, credentials, private token, CAPTCHA/Cloudflare bypass, unsafe field request, or TLS verification disable was used.
